en_title: The Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Beta Proves Fans Still Really Want That Blade Movie
subtitle: 最高同时在线破纪录

paragraphs.en: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is coming off a record-breaking open beta weekend, where two particular characters reigned supreme over the rest of the game’s cast.
paragraphs.cn: 《Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls》刚结束一个破纪录的公开测试周末，两名角色的使用率远超其他角色。

paragraphs.en: Despite some glaring issues that plagued PC users, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls still had a massively successful open beta, raking in more players on Steam than any other fighting game’s open beta before it.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管PC玩家遇到一些明显问题，《Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls》公开测试仍大获成功，Steam玩家数超过此前任何格斗游戏的公开测试。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, Marvel Tokon attracted 33,233 players at its all-time peak, just under 500 more than Street Fighter 6’s famously packed beta back in 2023. For reference, that number was 32,787 , while, for comparison’s sake, Tekken 8’s open beta garnered 15,035 players later that same year.
paragraphs.cn: 具体而言，《Marvel Tokon》峰值达33,233人，比2023年《街头霸王6》知名火爆的测试峰值32,787人高出近500人；同年《铁拳8》公开测试则有15,035人。

paragraphs.en: Of those players, a significant portion of them chose two characters more than any others. Those characters are Magick and Blade, respectively, with Magick being the consistent leader of the two. As seen in stats presented by the FGC’s resident data-compiler and infographic creator AlietteFaye, character usage in Vibranium ranks and above saw an overwhelming majority using Magick overall, as well as using her as a Team Leader.
paragraphs.cn: 这些玩家中，相当一部分最常选择秘客和刀锋战士，其中秘客始终领先。格斗游戏社群数据整理者兼信息图制作者AlietteFaye的统计显示，在振金段位及以上，秘客无论总体使用率还是作为队长都占压倒性优势。

paragraphs.en: Blade wasn’t far behind, ranking as the second most-used character overall. His position fell to fourth when it came to Team Leaders, with Spidey and Shuri in second and third place, though he was by far the most popular Assist Character out of the lot. Magick still maintained her popularity in this regard, coming in second as an Assist.
paragraphs.cn: 刀锋战士紧随其后，总使用率第二；在队长选择上他降至第四，蜘蛛侠和舒莉分列二、三位，但他是最受欢迎的辅助角色。秘客作为辅助角色仍居第二。

paragraphs.en: Magneto and Spider-Man were Tokon’s third and fourth-most popular picks, both in overall usage and as Assist characters, while on the other end of the lineup, Danger was consistently the least popular character in all aspects. Miss Marvel was just ahead of her in overall usage and assists, but was far more popular as a Team Leader.
paragraphs.cn: 万磁王和蜘蛛侠是《Tokon》第三、第四热门选择，在总使用率与辅助角色中皆是如此；另一端，Danger在各项上始终最不受欢迎。惊奇女士的总使用率和辅助使用略高于她，但作为队长受欢迎得多。

paragraphs.en: A final look at the character usage in Vibranium and above during Tokon's open beta.
paragraphs.cn: 最后来看《Tokon》公开测试期间振金段位及以上的角色使用情况。

paragraphs.en: Data was taken just before the servers went down!
paragraphs.cn: 数据采集于服务器关闭前不久。

paragraphs.en: While this data was only compiled within the game’s highest ranks, it certainly reflects many of the matches we saw over the weekend. You couldn’t go online without seeing a Magick or a Blade, a trend that speaks to their popularity within the broader gaming community.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然这些数据只来自游戏最高段位，却确实反映了周末大量对局：一上线几乎总会碰到秘客或刀锋战士，这一趋势说明他们在更广泛玩家群体中的人气。

paragraphs.en: It’s little surprise that Blade was one of the most-used characters during the open beta. Fans have been pining for another Blade movie and video game for ages now, with Marvel President Kevin Feige recently admitting he felt like a “gigantic loser and failure” for not getting the Mahershala Ali flick off the ground after seven years.
paragraphs.cn: 刀锋战士成为公开测试最常用角色之一并不意外。粉丝多年来一直期待新的《刀锋战士》电影与游戏；漫威总裁凯文·费奇近日承认，马赫沙拉·阿里主演的电影筹备七年仍未启动，让他觉得自己是「巨大的失败者」。

paragraphs.en: The Daywalker’s game adaptation is also in peril, with Xbox looking to either sell or close Arkane, the studio responsible for its development, in the thick of .
paragraphs.cn: 这位「日行者」的游戏改编也岌岌可危：XBOX正考虑出售或关闭负责开发的Arkane工作室。

paragraphs.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said the development house "is beginning required consultation with its Works Council to review potential strategic options, ” leaving fans hopeful that there is some light at the end of the tunnel for a Blade game.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX CEO阿莎·夏尔马表示，该工作室「正开始与劳资委员会进行必要协商，以审议潜在战略选项」，让粉丝仍希望《刀锋战士》游戏尚有转机。

paragraphs.en: For now, players have Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls to look forward to, which releases on August 6, 2026. Marvel's Wolverine isn't far behind either, releasing in September 15, 2026 for the PlayStation 5.
paragraphs.cn: 目前玩家可期待《Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls》于2026年8月6日发售；《漫威金刚狼》也不远了，将于2026年9月15日登陆PlayStation 5。

summary: 《Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls》公开测试峰值33,233人，创格斗游戏公开测试新高。秘客和刀锋战士最受欢迎，后者的人气也再次凸显玩家对《刀锋战士》电影和游戏的期待。
opus_summary: 《Marvel Tokon》测试以纪录级在线人数证明漫威格斗游戏的吸引力，而刀锋战士的高使用率也让长期搁置的影视与游戏计划更显可惜。
